risk_classes.description: Read-only investigation or decision work with no host mutation.
Bounded host change with limited scope but meaningful compatibility or availability risk.
Change can disrupt service, state, connectivity, recovery, or a security boundary.
Change can cause major state loss, loss of management access, or recovery requiring external intervention.

scope_classes.description: Bootstrap and repository-management tooling on one host.
Host-level language or container runtime capability.
Connectivity, routing, naming, or network control.
Filesystem or mount configuration and capability.
Block storage, capacity, layout, or retention infrastructure.
Application-owned version, data, or migration behavior.
Reference to externally provided secret material; never the value.
Backup readiness, recovery source, or protected state.

approval_classes.description: Only non-mutating work within an already approved observation boundary.
Explicit approval by the responsible operator bound to one plan fingerprint.
Explicit approval acknowledging privileged or high-impact host scope.
Approval by an application, security, storage, or other external authority.
The action may never be selected by an automatic execution policy.

approval_states.description: Explicit approval is required and has not been granted.
A model approval record grants the exact plan under its constraints.
Plan, policy, resolved state, drift, or action identity changed.
No approval is required for the item.

precondition_states.description: The prerequisite must be checked before any future execution.
Available evidence proves execution must not proceed.
The prerequisite does not apply to this proposal.

rollback_classes.description: No persistent state reversal is expected, though validation remains required.
A reviewed, specific reversal or version restore procedure must exist.
A verified recovery source is mandatory before the change.
Recovery requires a documented human-operated procedure.
No automatic rollback is considered safe; execution stays specially constrained.

failure_classes.description: Stop further actions and preserve evidence.
Stop and invoke a separately implemented reviewed rollback path.
Stop and transfer control to the documented human recovery process.
Stop and generate fresh observation, drift, and planning state.

action_classes.description: Provision or change an approved host tool or runtime through a future allowlisted implementation.

preconditions.description: The target host policy is approved and still satisfied.
The future package or runtime source and version are reviewed.
A defined version rollback or restore path exists.

validation_expectations.description: Bounded host inspection observes the required capability.
A fresh drift report marks the source requirement SATISFIED.

action_classes.rollback_expectation: Retain a reviewed version restore or host recovery procedure before execution.

action_classes.description: Change start, stop, restart, enablement, or service-manager state through a future dedicated implementation.

preconditions.description: The service manager and intended state are approved.
Any required service interruption window is approved.

validation_expectations.description: A bounded state check observes the required service state.
A fresh drift report marks the source requirement SATISFIED.

action_classes.rollback_expectation: Persistent rollback is not assumed; stop and reassess if service validation fails.

action_classes.description: Change reviewed non-secret host configuration without embedding executable instructions.

preconditions.description: Approved configuration is available without resolving secret values into the plan.
The prior configuration or an equivalent recovery source is verified.
A reviewed configuration restore procedure exists.

validation_expectations.description: Safe observation proves the intended capability without disclosing configuration values.
A fresh drift report marks the source requirement SATISFIED.

action_classes.rollback_expectation: Verify and retain the prior configuration before any future execution.

action_classes.description: Change filesystem or mount configuration; formatting and destructive layout changes are outside this class.

preconditions.description: Affected authoritative state has a verified recovery source.
A manual mount and recovery path is documented.

validation_expectations.description: Sanitized inspection observes the required filesystem or mount capability.
A fresh drift report marks the source requirement SATISFIED.

action_classes.rollback_expectation: A documented human recovery path and verified backup are required.

action_classes.description: Change storage capacity or layout; destructive formatting, partition replacement, and data deletion remain prohibited automatically.

preconditions.description: All affected authoritative state has a verified independent recovery source.
Capacity, retention, topology, and recovery design are approved.
Manual recovery personnel and procedure are available.

validation_expectations.description: Sanitized inspection proves the intended storage capability.
The backup authority independently verifies repository and recovery readiness.

action_classes.rollback_expectation: No automatic rollback is accepted; independent backup and manual recovery are mandatory.

action_classes.description: Change host network configuration with explicit protection against management-path loss.

preconditions.description: A tested management-independent recovery path is available.
A reviewed network rollback path is defined.

validation_expectations.description: Sanitized local observation proves the required capability without publishing addresses.
The operator independently verifies continued management access.

action_classes.rollback_expectation: Out-of-band access and a verified configuration recovery path must exist first.

action_classes.description: Sequence an application-owned migration contract without implementing application database changes in Kalvin.

preconditions.description: Application-authoritative state has a verified recovery source.
The owning application supplies and approves its migration and recovery contract.

validation_expectations.description: The owning application validates health and integrity through its existing checks.
Relevant external readiness gates are independently reevaluated.

action_classes.rollback_expectation: Application-owned restore or forward-recovery instructions and a verified backup are mandatory.

action_classes.description: Prepare or verify a recovery source under the backup authority's separate workflow.

preconditions.description: The approved backup authority and target policy are available.

validation_expectations.description: The backup authority verifies recovery usability without exposing protected content.

action_classes.rollback_expectation: Backup preparation must not replace or invalidate the prior recovery source.

action_classes.description: Resolve a secret or protected configuration reference through an external provider without exposing its value.

preconditions.description: The provider, ownership, and injection boundary are approved.
No secret value is present in planning or approval artifacts.

validation_expectations.description: The owning system confirms reference resolution without returning the protected value.

action_classes.rollback_expectation: Provider-specific recovery and revocation remain external responsibilities.

action_classes.description: Transition an approved repository or implementation version while preserving immutable identity and recovery evidence.

preconditions.description: The source and target are pinned to reviewed immutable identities.
Affected authoritative state has a verified recovery source.
A version restore or recovery plan is reviewed.

validation_expectations.description: The resolved deployment binds the expected immutable version.
Existing application-owned health checks pass where applicable.

action_classes.rollback_expectation: Retain the prior version identity and verified authoritative-state recovery source.

action_classes.description: Record an unresolved architecture or policy choice; it is not a host repair action.

preconditions.description: Relevant architecture, compatibility, and recovery evidence is reviewed.

validation_expectations.description: A later reviewed policy version records the decision explicitly.

action_classes.rollback_expectation: No host mutation occurs; supersede the policy decision through normal review.

finding_rules.summary: Select or approve a supported host platform before any reconstruction.
Approve the exact Ubuntu release range using compatibility evidence.
Review host architecture compatibility rather than treating hardware replacement as an automatic repair.
Provision an approved Kalvin Python runtime in a future reviewed phase.
Provision approved repository bootstrap tooling in a future reviewed phase.
Establish the approved service-manager capability through a future dedicated service workflow.
Provision the profile-approved container runtime only after the requirement policy marks it REQUIRED.

decision.summary: Decide whether this profile requires a container runtime and approve the supported runtime policy.
decision.why: The container-runtime requirement has not yet been approved for this profile.

finding_rules.summary: Restore bounded non-elevated block capability observation without disclosing device identity.
Restore bounded sanitized mount capability observation without disclosing endpoints.
Establish an approved network capability with management-path recovery protection.
Approve a workload-derived CPU sizing policy; do not infer a hardware upgrade.
Approve a workload-derived memory sizing policy; do not infer a hardware upgrade.
Approve the selected profile's local working-set and staging capacity policy.

summary_by_profile.lab: Define Lab capacity from the selected experimental components and local experimental working set without importing production sizing assumptions.
summary_by_profile.core: Define Core capacity from the application working set, migration and backup staging, and recovery workflow without making Core authoritative for long-term retention.

why_by_profile.lab: Lab capacity must reflect its selected experimental components and local experimental working set without becoming a production sizing baseline.
why_by_profile.core: Core capacity must cover its application working set, migration and backup staging, and recovery workflow while long-term retention remains authoritative elsewhere.

finding_rules.summary: Approve Storage retention, replication, protected working set, and safety margin policy.
Approve provider- and model-derived CPU, memory, GPU, and VRAM policy.
